{07 04 00}NOOOO!{01 00 00 0a 00} You can't carry any
more stuff, can you?!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0f 00} Like,
total bummer!
{07 14 00}Look, organize your stuff
and come see me again,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}{07 02 00}Oh, hey!{01 00 00 05 00} I totally didn't
thank you for the {ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00},
did I?

{07 04 00}Ooops! {01 00 00 14 00}{07 14 00}You did all that,
and I forgot to return the
favor, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 0b 00}Huh?{01 00 00 0a 00} Your pockets are still
TOTALLY full, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 06 00}YAAAA!{01 00 00 0a 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} why
didn't you LISTEN to me?

{07 04 00}OH NO!{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0b 00}You STILL haven't,
like, organized your stuff,
have you?
{07 14 00}Look, just come back when
you're ready, OK,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
